producer_report.summary:
I added the six records-history record types in crates/athena-data/src/history.rs, with validation and tests. `cargo test -p athena-data history` passes (12 tests). I did not re-run fmt, clippy or the full workspace tests in this round.

The round-trip criterion was the one flagged. The test `every_type_round_trips_with_its_schema_tag` covers all six types. For each one it serializes to JSON, checks the text contains the schema tag, then parses it back and checks the result equals the original.

The declared intervention uses the tag `athena.declared-intervention/1` and the type `DeclaredIntervention`, so it does not clash with the existing `athena.intervention/1` record.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test -p athena-data: each of the six new record types (landing-intent, landing, intervention, checkpoint, legacy-exempt, import-manifest) serializes to JSON with a schema tag and deserializes back to an equal value.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test -p athena-data history passes. history::tests::every_type_round_trips_with_its_schema_tag loops over all() (all six HistoryRecord variants). For each it serializes to pretty JSON, asserts the text contains the "schema": "<tag>" line, then asserts HistoryRecord::parse(text) equals the original.

open_issues: Cargo.toml is unchanged because no dependency was needed.
The declared intervention uses the schema tag athena.declared-intervention/1 and the type DeclaredIntervention, to avoid a clash with the existing athena.intervention/1 record.
mistakes: My earlier report did not list the round-trip criterion as met. The work was already in place; this report adds it.
